body.zh-Hant: 尼韋勒1856年10月15日生於蒂勒，1876年入巴黎綜合理工學院，1878年畢業後進入砲兵。1900年夏，他隨法國遠征軍赴華，參與鎮壓義和團，其後在非洲服役。1914年9月烏爾克河戰役中，他率步兵攻擊克魯克所部第1集團軍第4軍的防線，同年10月與貝當同時晉升准將。
body.en: Nivelle was born at Tulle on 15 October 1856, entered the École Polytechnique in 1876 and left it in 1878 for the artillery. In the summer of 1900 he went to China with the French expeditionary corps during the Boxer revolt, and then served in Africa. At the battle of the Ourcq in September 1914 he threw his infantry against the lines of the 4th Corps of von Kluck's 1st Army, and in October 1914 was promoted brigadier general at the same time as Pétain.

body.zh-Hant: 1916年2月起，尼韋勒在凡爾登前線指揮第2集團軍所屬第3軍，同年5月獲任第2集團軍司令，並於4月19日接替貝當。他指揮了瓦科、304高地等勝利戰鬥，並於1916年10月24日與下屬孟然一同收復杜奧蒙堡。這些戰果使他成為霞飛的指定接班人。
body.en: From February 1916 Nivelle led the 3rd Corps of the Second Army at Verdun, and in May 1916 he was given command of the Second Army, having succeeded Pétain on 19 April. He directed the victorious engagements at Vaux and Hill 304 and, with his subordinate Mangin, the recapture of Fort Douaumont on 24 October 1916. These successes made him the designated successor to Joffre.

heading.zh-Hant: 總司令與貴婦小徑攻勢
heading.en: Commander-in-chief and the Chemin des Dames

body.zh-Hant: 尼韋勒1916年12月12日就任法軍總司令。他主張打破陣地戰，於1917年4月16日發動貴婦小徑攻勢，但德軍已繳獲其作戰計畫並加強防禦，攻勢造成慘重傷亡而收效甚微。他於4月21日暫停進攻，5月初恢復；1917年5月15日由貝當接替。調查委員會認為他未能勝任這項艱鉅任務。
body.en: Nivelle took up the post of commander-in-chief of the army on 12 December 1916. Determined to break with positional warfare, he launched the Chemin des Dames offensive on 16 April 1917; the Germans had captured a copy of his plan and reinforced their positions, and the operation was a costly failure. He suspended the assault on 21 April and resumed it in early May, and was replaced by Pétain on 15 May 1917. An inquiry commission judged that he had not been equal to the crushing task.

body.zh-Hant: 失勢後，尼韋勒於1917年12月前往北非，出任阿爾及爾第19軍軍長，並擔任北非法軍司令，直至1921年退役。他隨後回到巴黎定居，三年後去世。
body.en: In disgrace, Nivelle went to North Africa in December 1917 to take command of the 19th Army Corps at Algiers as commander of French troops in North Africa, a function he held until his retirement in 1921. He then settled in Paris, where he died three years later.

heading.en: Early career and service with Joffre

body.zh-Hant: 甘末林1891年10月考入聖西爾軍校，1893年以第一名畢業，後以第八名考入高等戰爭學院。1901年晉升上尉，翌年進入霞飛的司令部，1906年出版《戰爭藝術的哲學研究》。1911年他出任第11山地獵兵營營長，為期兩年。
body.en: Gamelin entered Saint-Cyr in October 1891 and graduated first of his class in 1893; he was admitted eighth to the École de Guerre. Promoted captain in 1901, he joined General Joffre's staff the following year and in 1906 published a philosophical study of the art of war. In 1911 he took command of the 11th Alpine Chasseur Battalion for two years.

citations.quote: Admis en octobre 1891, il sort major de sa promotion en 1893
Admis huitième au concours de l'École de Guerre
Promu capitaine en 1901

body.zh-Hant: 1914年3月起，甘末林擔任霞飛的軍事辦公室主任。他起草第2號指令，並寫下發動馬恩河戰役攻勢的第6號指令。1916年12月他獲臨時准將軍階，任第16步兵師；1917年4、5月起指揮第9步兵師，1918年3月在努瓦永附近阻止德軍沿瓦茲河推進。
body.en: From March 1914 Gamelin served as head of Joffre's military cabinet. He drafted instruction no. 2 and wrote instruction no. 6, which launched the Marne offensive. Made temporary brigadier general in December 1916, he was assigned to the 16th Infantry Division, and from April–May 1917 he led the 9th Infantry Division, which blocked the German advance in the Oise around Noyon in March 1918.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰間期：敘利亞與總參謀長
heading.en: Interwar: Syria and chief of the general staff

body.zh-Hant: 1925年9月至1929年2月，甘末林在敘利亞指揮法軍，擔任高級專員的副手，負責鎮壓德魯茲山起義，1927年11月升任軍長。1931年2月9日他接替魏剛出任總參謀長，1935年1月任最高軍事委員會副主席，1938年1月21日出任國防參謀長。
body.en: From September 1925 to February 1929 Gamelin commanded French troops in Syria as deputy to the High Commissioner, tasked with putting down the Druze insurrection, and in November 1927 he became a corps general. On 9 February 1931 he replaced Weygand as chief of the general staff; in January 1935 he became vice-president of the Supreme War Council, and on 21 January 1938 chief of staff of national defence.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月，甘末林出任駐法盟軍總司令。他倚重馬其諾防線的防禦戰略，不願大規模運用裝甲與航空兵。1940年5月19日他被解除指揮權，9月6日被維琪政權逮捕，1942年2月19日在里翁高等法院受審，1943年3月被送往布痕瓦爾德，1945年5月5日在伊特被美軍解放。
body.en: In September 1939 Gamelin took command of the Allied forces in France. His strategy was a defensive one resting on the Maginot Line, and he refused to use armour and aviation en masse. On 19 May 1940 he was relieved of command; the Vichy regime arrested him on 6 September, he appeared before the High Court at Riom on 19 February 1942, was sent to Buchenwald in March 1943, and was freed by American troops on 5 May 1945.

heading.zh-Hant: 一九三〇年代的最高軍職

body.zh-Hant: 依法國國防部歷史處（SHD）的檔案指南，1930至1935年魏剛任最高軍事委員會副主席，甘末林任陸軍總參謀長；1935年1月18日的法令把這兩個職務合併。1938年1月21日的法令確認甘末林成為國防參謀長，可把國防總秘書處當作研究機構。義大利百科則記1940年5月19日他被解除指揮權。
body.en: According to the Service historique de la Défense guide, from 1930 to 1935 Weygand was vice-president of the Supreme War Council while Gamelin was chief of the general staff of the army; a decree of 18 January 1935 merged the two functions. A decree of 21 January 1938 confirmed Gamelin as chief of staff of national defence, able to use the national-defence secretariat as a study body. The Italian encyclopedia records that on 19 May 1940 he was relieved of command.

heading.en: Colonial campaigns and the Boxer expedition

body.zh-Hant: 弗朗謝·德斯佩雷1856年5月25日生於穆斯塔加內姆，1876年自聖西爾畢業。他參加突尼西亞對克魯米爾人的遠征，其後赴東京，參與諒山與老街的戰鬥。1900年他任法軍駐北京地區指揮官，參與對義和團的中國遠征，1903年晉升上校，統率駐貝桑松的第60步兵團。
body.en: Franchet d'Espèrey was born at Mostaganem on 25 May 1856 and left Saint-Cyr in 1876. He took part in the Tunisian expedition against the Kroumirs, then went to Tonkin, where he fought at Lang Son and Lao Cai. In 1900, as commander of the French zone of Peking, he joined the China expedition against the Boxers; promoted colonel in 1903, he commanded the 60th Infantry Regiment at Besançon.

body.zh-Hant: 1912年，師級將領弗朗謝·德斯佩雷在利奧泰手下擔任西摩洛哥占領軍司令，參與塔德拉、舍維亞與大阿特拉斯等地的綏靖行動。1914年戰爭爆發時他指揮駐里爾的第1軍，參加夏勒羅瓦戰役，並在瓦茲河畔的吉斯發動勝利的反攻；9月3日霞飛將第5集團軍交給他，該軍是馬恩河勝利的關鍵。
body.en: In 1912, as a divisional general, he served near Lyautey as commander of the occupation troops of western Morocco and took part in pacification operations in the Tadla, the Chaouïa and the Grand Atlas. At the outbreak of war he commanded the 1st Army Corps at Lille, fought at Charleroi and launched a victorious counter-attack at Guise on the Oise; on 3 September Joffre entrusted him with the 5th Army, a decisive element in the victory of the Marne.

body.zh-Hant: 弗朗謝·德斯佩雷1916年指揮東方集團軍群，1917年轉任北方集團軍群。1918年6月他接替紀堯馬，統率盟軍東方軍，發動摩格萊納攻勢並攻占多布羅波列，1918年9月迫使保加利亞簽署停戰協定。
body.en: He commanded the Army Group of the East in 1916 and the Army Group of the North in 1917. In June 1918 he replaced General Guillaumat at the head of the Allied armies of the Orient and led them to final victory: his Moglena offensive, marked by the capture of Dobro Polje, forced the Bulgarians to sign the armistice in September 1918.

body.zh-Hant: 戰後他統率君士坦丁堡占領軍至1920年，並指揮烏克蘭與比薩拉比亞的行動。1921年晉升法國元帥，其後任北非部隊總監。1934年當選法蘭西學術院院士，1942年7月8日在塔恩的聖阿芒塞去世。
body.en: After the war he commanded the occupation troops at Constantinople until 1920 and directed the operations in Ukraine and Bessarabia. He was raised to Marshal of France in 1921 and became inspector general of the troops of North Africa. Elected to the Académie française in 1934, he died at Saint-Amancet in the Tarn on 8 July 1942.

heading.zh-Hant: 元帥、北非視察與學術院
heading.en: Marshal, North African inspections and the Académie

body.zh-Hant: 法蘭西學術院記載，他在1921年2月21日獲頒元帥權杖。國防部歷史處的檔案說明寫道，元帥視察北非部隊直到1931年。學術院另載他於1934年11月15日獲選，並由阿貝爾·博納爾在1935年6月20日致歡迎詞；他於1942年7月8日去世。
body.en: The Académie française records that he received his marshal's baton on 21 February 1921. The Service historique de la Défense archive description says the marshal inspected the North African troops until 1931. The Académie also records his election on 15 November 1934, his reception by Abel Bonnard on 20 June 1935, and his death on 8 July 1942.

body.en: Weygand was born in Brussels on 21 January 1867, entered Saint-Cyr in 1885 and, after graduating in 1887, chose the cavalry. He became a captain in 1896 and a lieutenant-colonel in 1912, was noticed as an instructor at the Cavalry School at Saumur, and then joined the Centre of Higher Military Studies.

heading.zh-Hant: 與福煦並肩的一戰歲月
heading.en: The First World War at Foch's side

body.zh-Hant: 1914年魏剛率第5驃騎兵團參加莫朗日戰役，8月28日升上校並調至福煦身邊。1916年他升准將，1918年3月26日杜朗會議後出任盟軍最高司令福煦的參謀長（major général），並與福煦在1918年11月談判停戰條款。
body.en: In 1914 Weygand fought at Morhange at the head of the 5th Hussars; promoted colonel on 28 August, he was attached to Foch. He became a brigadier general in 1916. After the Doullens meeting of 26 March 1918 he served as Foch's major général in the new allied supreme command, and the two men negotiated the armistice terms in November 1918.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰間期：敘利亞與參謀總長
heading.en: Interwar: Syria and chief of staff

body.zh-Hant: 1920年魏剛赴波蘭擔任畢蘇斯基元帥的軍事顧問，1923年晉升集團軍級將領並接替古羅出任敘利亞高級專員。回國後他進入最高軍事委員會，主持高等軍事研究中心，1930年出任陸軍總參謀長，1931年2月9日由甘末林接替，1935年退出現役。
body.en: In 1920 Weygand went to Poland as military adviser to Marshal Piłsudski; in 1923 he became an army general and replaced Gouraud as High Commissioner in Syria. Back in France he joined the Supreme War Council and directed the Centre of Higher Military Studies. Promoted chief of the general staff of the army in 1930, he was replaced by Gamelin on 9 February 1931 and left active service in 1935.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年大戰爆發，魏剛受召統率中東法軍；1940年5月雷諾召他回巴黎接替甘末林出任最高統帥。1940年6月貝當取代雷諾後，他出任國防部長（6至9月），9月起任維琪政府駐非洲總代表，1941年11月被召回本土，1942年11月被德軍逮捕，1948年獲不起訴處分。
body.en: When war came in 1939 Weygand was recalled to command French forces in the Middle East; in May 1940 Reynaud called him back to Paris to succeed Gamelin in supreme command. After Pétain replaced Reynaud he became Minister of National Defence (June–September 1940), then delegate general of the Vichy government in Africa from September 1940. Vichy recalled him to France in November 1941, the Germans arrested him in November 1942, and he received a dismissal of charges in 1948.

heading.zh-Hant: 敘利亞高級專員與維琪時期的任命
heading.en: High Commissioner in Syria and the Vichy appointments

body.zh-Hant: 法國外交部檔案寫道，1923年4月魏剛接替古羅出任高級專員，下一任薩拉伊於1924年11月獲任命。法蘭西學術院記載他在1931年6月11日獲選。依國防部歷史處的檔案指南，1940年9月6日法令把他任命為政府駐法屬北非總代表，國防部同日撤銷；義大利百科則記他在1941年11月18日應德方要求被召回。
body.en: The French diplomatic archives state that in April 1923 Weygand replaced Gouraud as high commissioner, and that his successor Sarrail was appointed in November 1924. The Académie française records his election on 11 June 1931. According to the Service historique de la Défense guide, a decree of 6 September 1940 appointed him delegate general of the government in French North Africa and the Ministry of National Defence was abolished the same day; the Italian encyclopedia notes he was recalled on 18 November 1941 at German insistence.

body.zh-Hant: 坎皮奧尼1878年11月14日生於維亞雷焦，自利沃諾海軍學院畢業。他參加義土戰爭與第一次世界大戰，主要在上亞得里亞海作戰。1926年任上校，1932年任少將，1938年出任海軍參謀次長，1939年3月25日獲任參議員。
body.en: Campioni was born at Viareggio on 14 November 1878 and left the naval academy at Livorno in 1896. He took part in the Italo-Turkish war and the First World War, fighting chiefly in the upper Adriatic. He became a captain in 1926 and rear admiral in 1932, was made deputy chief of the naval staff in 1938 and was appointed senator on 25 March 1939.

heading.zh-Hant: 海戰：普恩塔斯蒂洛與特拉達角
heading.en: Naval battles: Punta Stilo and Cape Teulada

body.zh-Hant: 義大利參戰後，坎皮奧尼以海上最高指揮官身分參加1940年7月9日的普恩塔斯蒂洛海戰，又在1940年11月27日的特拉達角海戰中指揮義大利艦隊。後一戰未能達成阻止英軍兩支船團會合的目的，偵察機缺位使他選定的戰術落空。12月8日他重任海軍參謀次長。
body.en: After Italy entered the war Campioni took part, as senior commander at sea, in the battle of Punta Stilo on 9 July 1940, and commanded the Italian fleet at Cape Teulada on 27 November 1940. In the latter the aim of preventing the junction of two British convoys was not achieved, and the absence of reconnaissance aircraft frustrated his chosen tactics. On 8 December he resumed the post of deputy chief of the naval staff.

heading.en: Governor of the Aegean and the 1943 surrender

body.zh-Hant: 1941年7月22日，坎皮奧尼接替巴斯蒂科出任愛琴海總督兼最高司令。1943年9月8日停戰消息傳來，他毫無準備；他向德軍指揮官通報羅馬的命令後，德軍迅速占領島上要點，他為避免平民傷亡而接受投降，並應德方要求再行使民政權力十天，隨後辭職。
body.en: On 22 July 1941 Campioni was named governor and senior commander of the Aegean, succeeding General Bastico. The armistice announcement on 8 September 1943 caught him wholly unprepared; after he informed the German commander of the orders received, the Germans swiftly occupied the key points of the island, and he accepted surrender to avoid needless bloodshed, keeping civil powers for ten days at German request before resigning.

citations.quote: il 22 luglio del 1941 egli venne nominato governatore e comandante superiore
succedendo nella carica al generale E. Bastico
L'8 sett. 943 l'annuncio dell'armistizio lo colse del tutto impreparato
occupò repentinamente i punti chiave dell'isola
accettò nell'intento di evitare inutili spargimenti di sangue
mantenne però per dieci giorni i poteri civili, dando quindi le dimissioni

body.zh-Hant: 坎皮奧尼與馬斯凱帕被押往波蘭的舒肯營，1944年1月被德方送回義大利並交給法西斯當局。1944年5月22日帕爾馬特別法庭以其服從巴多格里奧命令並放棄多德卡尼斯為由判處死刑，5月24日黎明在帕爾馬靶場槍決；1947年11月追贈金質軍事勇敢勳章。
body.en: Campioni and Mascherpa were deported to the camp at Schokken in Poland, and in January 1944 the Germans returned him to Italy and handed him over to the Fascists. The trial opened at Parma on 22 May 1944, accusing him of obeying Badoglio's orders and surrendering the Dodecanese; he was executed at the Parma firing range at dawn on 24 May 1944, and in November 1947 was posthumously awarded the Gold Medal of Military Valor.

citations.quote: nel campo di Schokken in Polonia
nel gennaio del '44 venne dai Tedeschi riportato in Italia
Il processo ebbe inizio il 22 maggio nella sede delle assise di Parma
accusati di aver aderito agli ordini di Badoglio e di aver ceduto il Dodecanneso
nel poligono di tiro di Parma all'alba del 24 maggio 1944
nel novembre 1947, gli veniva conferita la medaglia d'oro al valor militare

body.zh-Hant: 義大利百科記載，他1926年任上校級艦長，1927年任駐巴黎武官，1932年晉升少將，1934年任中將級海軍將領並兼海軍部辦公室主任，1936年晉升上將，1938年任海軍參謀次長，1939年成為參議員。ANPI 的人物頁另提到，他戰時任海軍參謀次長，後因年齡限制列入輔助役，並被任命為愛琴海總督。
body.en: The Italian encyclopedia records that he was captain (capitano di vascello) in 1926, military attaché in Paris in 1927, rear admiral in 1932, divisional admiral in 1934 and head of the cabinet at the Ministry of the Navy, full admiral in 1936, deputy chief of the naval staff in 1938 and senator in 1939. The ANPI biography adds that during the war he served as deputy chief of the naval staff and was later placed on the auxiliary list for age limits and named governor of the Aegean islands.
